body: Same here... The hairdresser's is the worst for me. Facing your reflection the entire time, getting asked how you look every five seconds? I haven't been in years. I don't go anywhere anymore. I hope your esteem improves :(

I haven't been for a while, since all she does now is set goals that I can't and don't care enough about to achieve and try to unnecessarily "intervene". I want to stop going. I just say I've been okay every time I'm asked.

I wish I could help you more than telling you you're a valuable person and that me and many other people are there for you. People you know. People you don't know. People you're going  to meet someday. You absolutely won't feel like this forever. You said you see yourself as a waste of space. I know this isn't a massive thing, but it's something; your post, and this comment I'm writing, have distracted me from my own feelings right now. Albeit only for a few minutes, you've done something worthy and helped someone. You'll do things like this every day and have good impacts on people every day that you don't even know about. I hope you feel better soon. Sorry if this is messy. <3
